scope: Board mounting data transcribed from the official Arduino datasheet drawings (docs.arduino.cc). Uno overall outline is not dimensioned in the official datasheet and is intentionally absent.

records.coordinate_system: Mounting-hole drawing, view from top side. Origin at the top-left corner of the board outline as drawn, x right, y down. The drawing does not dimension the overall board length or width.

mount_hole_count.locator: Datasheet PDF page 12, section 5.4 Board Outline & Mounting Holes
